rationale: Bike was taken without permission from a public bike rack, clearly constituting theft covered under the renters policy.
claim_summary: Blake Okafor's 2024 commuter bike valued at $800 was stolen yesterday morning from a bike rack at their office building. Security cameras are available. This is a straightforward theft claim under their active renters policy (POL-1007) with a $250 deductible.

case_facts.location: bike rack in front of office building
